key_stat: $1.8T wealth client assets | $355B alternative AUS | 12K engineers
summary: Goldman Sachs is focused on Global Banking & Markets and Asset & Wealth Management after retreating from consumer banking (Marcus scaling back). Q3 2025 revenue $15.18B with 20%+ ROE. Wealth client assets $1.8T. Alternatives AUS $355B with $18B quarterly fundraising. Technology: 12,000 engineers with AI Developer Copilot (15% bug reduction), Banker Copilot, Research Assistant. Plans for hundreds of autonomous AI coding agents (3-4x productivity). GS DAP tokenization platform to be spun out mid-2026. CEO Solomon focused on operating efficiency and AI. David Solomon stated goal to 'operate more efficiently to seamlessly deliver the firm to clients helped by new AI technologies.'
